title: Here’s Where to Watch ‘The Voice’ Season 30 Online for Free
summary: The reality competition premieres with a special three-night event starting on Monday, Sept. 21.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After Alexia Jayy won the previous “Battle of Champions” season back in April, The Voice returns for season 30 — which is hosted by Carson Daly. Meanwhile, Adam Levine and Kelly Clarkson also return as coaches, while Riley Green and Queen Latifah make their debut on the coaching panel.

Beginning on Monday (Sept. 21), the reality competition premieres with a special three-night event.

How to Watch ‘The Voice’ Season 30 Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Starting on Monday, Sept. 21

- Network: NBC

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Peacock

Watch on DirecTV

What Time Does ‘The Voice’ Season 30 Start ?

The Voice season 30 begins with a special two-hour episode on Monday (Sept. 21), with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/PT. The second night then takes place on Tuesday (Sept. 22) and the third night on Wednesday (Sept. 23). Both nights are one-hour episodes starting at 8 p.m. ET/PT.

The reality competition broadcasts on Mondays until the season finale on NBC. It drops the following day on Peacock for on-demand streaming.

Where to Watch ‘The Voice’ Season 30 Online for Free

If you’re a fan of The Voice and cord-cutter, then there are a number of ways to watch without cable — especially if you want to watch for free. For example: DirecTV offers a five-day free trial to try out the streaming service, while others like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV offer free trials too, so you can watch NBC without spending money up front.

EDITOR'S PICK

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Comes with a five-day free trial.

You can watch local networks, such as NBC, CBS and FOX, while you can also watch many cable networks, including FX, AMC, A&E, Bravo, Cartoon Network, ESPN, FS1, VH1, Fuse, CNN, Food Network, Lifetime, CNBC, BET, MTV, Paramount Network and many others.

Sling TV

Get Sling TV

Sling Blue comes with 40+ channels.

Sling TV offers Blue, which comes with NBC. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month and comes with a free cloud DVR and additional free channels. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market to market.

FuboTV

The service gets you live access to local broadcast networks including NBC, CBS and FOX, while it also has dozens of cable networks, such as FX, Bravo, TLC, ESPN, E!, FS1, MTV, CMT, ID, Ion, OWN, Paramount Network, TV Land, VH1 and much more.

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited.

The broadcast network NBC is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV too. Prices for the cable alternative start at $89.99 per month, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package. It also features many other networks, like CBS, NBC, FOX, BET, CMT, Disney Channel, ESPN, Hallmark Channel and more.

Peacock

Get Peacock Premium

The official NBC streamer.

There are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $12.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $19.99 per month. If you’re looking to save, you can get 17% off when you do the annual plan for $129.99 per year or $199.99 per year, respectively. The Premium Plan is ad-supported, and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan , no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.

The streaming platform doesn’t offer a free trial, but Peacock does come with a couple of affordable plans starting at $12.99 per month. In addition, you can get 30 days of access to Peacock for as low as $1 with Walmart+ , as one of the service’s benefits and perks. Learn more about Walmart+ and Peacock here .

Alongside The Voice , you’ll have access to the entire Peacock library, including Obsession , The Paper , Yellowstone , Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 , The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills , Poker Face , Saturday Night Live and others.

The streaming service also offers a number of music documentaries and specials, such as Toby Keith: An American Icon , Bowie: The Man Who Changed the World , Bob Dylan: The Folk Years , Stevie Nicks: Through the Looking Glass , Katy Perry: Main Square , Welcome to the A: 50 Years of Hip-Hop in Atlanta and more.

The Voice season 30 broadcasts Mondays starting Sept. 21 at 8 p.m. ET/PT on NBC. One of the best ways to watch is with DirecTV .
